truth_boundary: The sourced q relation uses q^(+2h), not q^(-2h).
The coordinate identities are stated for 0<h<1/2; the theorem later chooses h<1/100.
Eq. (4.5) gives the leading field from profiles; it does not provide a final numerical profile table.
A numerical implementation of the leading field is not the complete corrected theorem field.
Visual correspondence, PDE validation and paper-exact recovery remain separate claims.
